candidate.accessibility_delta: Could make difficult low-acceptance spans less wasteful on local hardware.
candidate.baseline_to_beat: DFlash, SSD-lite without bonus prediction, and no branch precompute.
candidate.description: Saguaro-inspired branch predictor focused specifically on rejection/bonus-token states.
candidate.hypothesis: Predicting the target bonus token after rejection can rescue low-acceptance speculative rounds and improve branch precomputation value.
candidate.implementation: Collect rejection-round traces, train bonus-token ranker, evaluate top-k hit and branch usefulness, then pair with SSD-lite only if low-acceptance tasks benefit.
candidate.kill_condition: Stop if residual token distribution is too flat or branches are rarely used.
likely_failure_modes: Sampling makes bonus token too diffuse
Only works in trivial structured cases
candidate.mechanism: Train a top-k bonus-token predictor on rejection rounds and precompute continuations from likely bonus tokens.
candidate.novelty_comparison: Narrower and more testable than full SSD: only predicts rejection bonus branches.
